text: I'm giving a 1 star for multiple reasons. 1) The game is not what is shown in advertisements. It's completely different and is a pay to play type of game. 2) It's heavily focused on PvP. The further you go, you'll notice you basically just need to PvP to get more resources. You could get away with bot doing it, but you just risk players attacking you more and not being able to progress because of it.

Pros: The art is good. The characters are interesting, and the city buildings are appealing. CONS: the game is another one of those pay-to-win whale versus free victims games. The tower defense ads that they've been running is misleading, its just guild wars all over again. Misleading at best, little fun here can be found for casual gamers.

Pay-to-win. Misleading ads. Copycat of Last Land: War of Survival. Whoever spends the most will win. Expect your purchases will eventually be stranded on a server with dwindling activity. If you struggle to stay on budget, avoid the game. In two days of play there was scant resemblance to the ads. Tower defense aspect exists but seems to be very minor. Main strategy play & combat seem nearly identical to Last Land: WoS. It lacks some of the fluffy distractions and graphics feel different.

Is this game anything like the tower defense ads? NO. BUT, keep reading, the game is a story game/fighting game where you have to fight raids, upgrade builds, and expand your empire. I actually found the game pretty fun when it comes to playability and the concept. I really wish the ads did not decide me or others like it did. Which is my I only give 3 stars. In conclusion, it's not what it is in the ads but it is still a fun game.

FALSE ADVERTISING would be something that I can't say about this game. I can say that this game plays nothing like the ads. If you came here for "hours of tower defense action" then you may be disappointed. This game absolutely has its fun parts, but none of that is advertised and the main selling point, tower defense, does not exist in the same way it is shown in the ad. It is a completely different system. It is not a real time tower defense. This is a clash of clans like game... with towers.

It's not bad. I was shocked to hear voice acting, I think the tutorial was okay, and I like the simplicity of it, but I think it could be better. I don't like that in the beginning, we had access to 2 construction slots, but after some time, the second one just disappears which is just weird and aggrevating. Next is the fact that there's nothing to do when you're idle. Once you start construction and reach your conquer limit, there's NOTHING to do. Maybe let us cook meals or gather resources.

Within a short time of starting the game, you're instructed to build things like an embassy, an arena, guard station, barracks, conquerors camp, court of justice, half a dozen houses, and so so many other things. and on the screen that you play on, there's like 10 different tabs that have notification dots lit up constantly. just way too much going on, and it is unclear how they all affect your end goal.

Exceptionally unremarkable. There is nothing about this game that makes me want to come back after five days of play. The ad showed gameplay that was different from the actual game, by enough it deems worthy of note. It's a timer game. Upgrade the thing wait the time, or pay money to skip the wait. Lame. It's colorful and nicely animated. I lowered it's rating after more time played. Developer! I have now played 5 days. Town hall lvl 10. Your ad is misleading. Your game is lame.

Edit: the generic response by the developer to every single person that complains about the ads, is ridiculous. The ads draw you in, yet the game play in the ads is NOT in the game. It's false advertising, period. Slow, boring and not like the ads. If you see the ads and it looks fun, it's a lie. There is nothing in the game like that. You spend all of your time building and waiting, you control no attacks at all. I wasted time building to level 7 and uninstalled.

Constant advertisements to spend money in game. Definitely pay to win or you need to devote an unhealthy amount of time to get/stay strong in this game. Events get repetitive. Many game/event mechanics designed to make you spend money or tempt you to spend money (like having some kind of gambling/chance mechanic). Trying to delete your account results in an error and game devs haven't deleted my account even after a month of back and forth. This game is not a tower defense, it's a strategy game.

Not the game I saw in the ad. In the ad there was a constant stream of enemies flowing from a spawner and I could build guard towers / spawners of my own, as the enemies were coming, just by standing on certain squares for building. Once enough of my towers were built to generate more troops than the enemy spawner, the enemy was forced back to their base and defeated. But the real game is NOTHING like that. Instead it's a full blown town building game with just a few combat elements.

This game is fully PAY TO WIN, and heavily incentivizes and encourages you to spend, every day, every time you play. In order to remain competitive, especially in the mid to late game, you essentially have to pay or you will get steamrolled by players who have. I've played this game for 5 months, almost every day, so I would say my experience is deeper than those who played for 3-4 days and wrote a positive review about how the game is "not pay to win" and "relaxing" etc.

So disappointing! I was really looking forward to playing this game based on how it was played through ads that would pop up but the game is nothing like the ads. It's horrible. Instead of fighting like you do when you play in the ads, you're stuck building and reading script and hiring hands. It's just not fun at all. I've spent the past 20 minutes hitting the OK button while it builds buildings and collects keys, jewels, and other stuff. I'm so disappointed. Make the game like the ads!!!

Constant "Buy This Treasure Chest" Ads Popping Up. I am literally deleting my account because I can't stand it anymore. I can be looking at upgrading something in my village and it will pull me out of that screen to show me a pop-up ad. And it does this over and over again until you buy that chest. The only screens it does pop over are battle scenes. Get rid of them and this game is maybe a 4 star. And then there's the fact that this game is just kind of boring and different from what I wanted.

Not really like the game in the ads or picture description. You spend a lot of time building a city mostly. Also too many mechanics early on, constantly clicking. Edit: after playing the game for several days the aspects of the game from the ads are nowhere to be found. removed an additional star for deceptive advertising. This is click builder city game with timers and some lame combat elements.

this game is NOTHING like the ads. this company and the thirsty influencers need to be held accountable. this is basically a multi player castle and unit game that will require money to be competitive. prepare to be disappointed. Edit: in response to the developer responding to my review. I did play the game. And you are lying still. the gameplay you ADVERTISE is nowhere in the game. And I'm not the only one calling you out. The core gameplay is COMPLETELY DIFFERENT from the ads.

Really disappointed. I just wanted the light hearted play in the ad. Not to devote my existence to starting tasks and waiting for them to end to be able to move on. It's nothing like the ad and there's nothing rewarding about wasting time on this game. Also waking up to find your defenses decimated, even with a shield, is pure evil. Do they expect you to be online 24/7? Lowering rating from 2 stars to 1.

Reducing to 1 star. Developers if you're going to respond you should actually read & not copy paste a generic message that doesn't apply. Nothing wrong with the game. The add makes it appear to be a game you can enjoy playing on your own, building and strategizing. In fact it is not, it is Whiteout Survival without the snow. I like playing Whiteout Survival, but I'm not trying to play another game exactly like it. I was excited to be able to play this one quietly by myself, huge disappointment!

I downloaded this game based off a playable ad from another game. Well it is nothing like the ad! Though that was a bit disappointing at first, I've come to like the game a bit. The graphics feels like a knock off of CoC. In any case, I do like the ad-free game play and so far it seems like you don't really need to spend money to progress in the game though obviously paying will help you progress faster. I hope it stays that way throughout the entire time unlike some games.

I'd say this is a pay-to-win rather than a free-to-play game, but games like this have no real ending or finish. It just goes on indefinitely and you have to spend money to buy some basic necessities just to be able to keep up at all with the game. I'd say the best part of this game is the social comradery with the people in your alliance, but the chat and interaction features are pretty limited. Having a Discord server for your alliance is an absolute must to be able to really communicate.

I LOVE this game. But unfortunately I am running into so many bugs.. which is very depressing and difficult being I was spending a lot of money and time on this game weekly, it's starting to affect my want to play it. 2 right now being. - I goto update my profile picture and it says "Image file editing not supported" -I goto create a second character on the same account and it loads then pops up nothing, I type in kingdom code and still blank.

Thought it was a simple tower defense game, but turns out to be another copycat town-building, time demanding, resource grinder that is only mildly enjoyable up until build times take days and you consistently get smashed by other players that have money to spend on nonsense like this. Nothing unique here. I do appreciate the lack of ads, the only thing that led me to consider trying it, but I'm looking for a time passer, not a second job that doesn't pay me.

I really like the game However.... The prices for upgrades are completely ridiculous! To load up on gems its 99 dollars and I even saw an upgrade on the games website for 1000 dollars. Thats right three zeros..... One thousand dollars! You have got to be kidding me! Most items are 9.99 and up. Simply ridiculous for a game!! A person could go buy a top of the line gaming system by the time you paid for this junk! Come on and stop being so greedy.....

Not like the Ad's! It's just another base building game. Where you attack other players and whoever is willing to spend the most money is king of the server. I used to play one of these games (ROE) a long time ago so it didnt take long for me to realize what it truly was. It has nothing to do with tower defense like tha ads. Which is sad cause I liked the little tower game in the ads lol.

I have yet to see these games that the ads show. Your Character doesn't run around doing things,building stuff. Your heroes don't run around like the ad. It Is free to play though. You just have to bleed for everything else that might keep you from being savaged by any and all players. This is a pay to win game, just like all the rest. I got a cookie-cutter reply. Play the game more, they told me. Instead of an idiotic response, how about telling me WHERE to find it in the game.

Downloaded this because the tower defense ad looked genuinely fun. Unfortunately, that's mostly just bait. Once you're invested, the real game reveals itself: long timers, endless grind, and constant pressure to spend money. The biggest issue is the misleading advertising. The tower defense gameplay that got me to download the game is a small side activity, while the actual game is a pay to win kingdom builder. The ad was better than the game itself....

Ads are a lie. Game play is either wait for ever for a building to build and troops to train, OR spend a ton of money make these things happen faster. There's gotcha elements. You can grind to earn a hero shard, or spend money to buy a bunch of shards. Players will sink a ton into this game, and then a different player with a higher spending account will destroy them. That part is entertaining. If you're F2P you need to research best strategies or you will fall behind and never catch up.

Bait and Switch. I installed this game after playing an ad that they had on another app. besides the sprite for the king unit, nothing is the same and not fun/engaging as the demo. terrible. edit to respond to the comment: at no point in this game does it change to the gameplay footage in the ad. I checked online and a lot of people report the same thing .

was a good kill time game. Then was repetitive. level 20. 3 days to level up a kingdom castle. nothing really exciting after leveling up. like usual older games. pay to play. but still not entertaining. your numbers just get higher. reaching level 19 I guess you get island to decorate? lame was looking more for a war craft style game. I think I'll go back to boom beach. its a straight up battle game.

If you're looking for the game where you build towers with a king & archers, fight off people, & build a fort rapidly, this isn't it. That is the ad I saw & played for this game, & downloaded it based off of, but there isn't a single example of that anywhere yet & I've been playing daily for about a month. still it is a decent game. it requires a lot of time & consistency to level & get anywhere. one also needs to join one of the big organized alliances to get any decent assistance & guidance.

The ads that are seen everywhere for this game do not do the game justice. I've played the game and it is heavily dependent on preying upon other players to get ahead. That isn't my jam. I don't mind being part of an Alliance and the whole Team going against another whole Team of Members, but going up against one lone player just isn't my idea of fun. I hate being preyed upon. The Beasts and other Event Monsters to go after are great but it is Pay-to-Win at a certain point and player eat player

this is probably not the game you think it is. the ads are a lie. it is absolutely pay to win. and if you want to be on top of your server, it's probably in the thousands of dollars. I find this gaming model to be predatory. and to top it off, they make it very hard to delete your account. they ask for information that is very difficult to find in order to "prove your identity". this also feels criminal

The game is really fun. The only problems are the glitches. When I participated in a 7-day competition, I tried to collect the 7th day reward (there is one for every day) and it never made it to my inventory. I contacted support to see if I could resolve the problem, to be met with skepticism. I understand that the game attracts a lot of scammers with fake profiles, as do many games. Every online platform experiences this, but it goes without saying, "don't paint everyone with a broad brush."

I really was enjoying this game but they recently added an All Out event which directly incentivizes high level players to endlessly attack low level players for 2 days every month. they remove all items from the shops that allow you to defend yourself so you have to just sit and watch week and weeks of progress get wiped out. and then decide if you want to rebuild to get wiped out again. it's a terrible anti player thing and as long as it's around I cannot recommend the game

The game itself I enjoyed at first. Not a true single player, you are capped at level 11 unless you join an alliance and then you have to worry about being attacked. I hate when they lie to you and you invest time in a game only to find out its not a true single player. Its getting hard to find a game like this that is a real single player where you don't have to interact with others. I did contact them through the game and they even said they promote interaction between players.

since last nights update its been lagging freezing up, not showing things I say for minutes on my end, not showing peoples profile pictures. hell I cant even get it to allow me to go through the contact us section. the only thing that aliviates the issues is to clear the cashed data and im sorry but if I have to clear the cashe every day I wanna play then its not worth it to play. otherwise its an amazing game! though other people make it hard to play especially with the koreans in my server.

Long live Kingdom 1064 (MJS). One of the few games you can get pretty far F2P but it may take awhile. Met great people along the way. There's no end game. For me just getting stronger and doing the same tasks day after day is time consuming and I've lost interest. The chats can keep you entertained with the different personalities. Overall it's not a bad game.

WARNING ⚠️ ⚠️ ⚠️ ⚠️ if you download this game and plan on spending any money on the dlc characters don't! it's not only a waste unless you're planning to spend 250+ dollars but it's also a scam.There is NO warning before buying the dlc characters that they are completely paid to win! that you can't upgrade them using general shards. The items you earn to lvl up characters. So now I just have a useless no lvl dlc character that I will never use. I refuse to spend another penny on this game.

Not the game in the advertisements. Pay to win. They should advertise the true game. The game isn't so bad, but it isn't what I was sold, and that is unacceptable. edit: the developer responded and said the ads show a small portion of the game... that's a lie. They don't show anything that exists in the game. The ad is completely different, and is similarly used by Lords Mobile but with their art instead of this game's art.

NOT a TD game at all. Normally I don't mind a misleading ad that may show you a mini game available in the game. This is not the case here. Ads and photo show a Tower Defense game. I've been playing for roughly 4 hours and not a trace of TD anywhere. it plays like a resource management game where you collect heroes and send out troops to collect more resources. There's conquest mode, but even that is a bit boring. I collected 5 heroes and have no desire to continue playing.

for once I would like to download a game and have it be exactly like the ads I see while playing other games. Kingshot is advertised as a tower defense type game. the demo that you get to play in the ads you get while playing other games seems fun and straight forward. I downloaded the game and have yet to play a version of what they advertised. I don't want to spend time building towns and allocating residents and upgrading buildings. Give me the simple tower defense from the ads.

Terrible advertising. Ad is 100% different than the game. I wanted a tower defense game and this is just another base builder. I know they'll respond with "play the game". I did. It's a base builder. I hate it. If your ad is highlighting 2% of what may be in your game, that's a horrible ad. I wish the Google Play store would start penalizing developers for this. The only reason they have so many downloads... is because they're liars.

Fun Until You Get Farmed This game started fun, and stayed fun for awhile. Then someone bigger than you teleports in and starts farming you. Then the fun stops. Bummer. Contacting Support just gets a response along the lines of them saying its a competitive style game. No it's not. You don't stand a chance if someone bigger shows up. They just want you to buy shields. Not really like the in-game adds I played in other games that got me to try the game in the first place.

nothing like the ad, hard to figure out. you work hard to build and certain events make you lose a lot of progress. unlike the developers comment below. the ad has nothing to do with the game. you do not run around shooting red army, collect coins and build things. You play hours a day and then one of the battles happens for which you can shield your settlement for 8 hours. you wake up and your settlement is on fire and you lost a lot of your work. Game deleted.

Disappointing. I downloaded this game after seeing the constant ads, but the actual gameplay is nothing like the ads. I thought I'd be shooting enemies, gathering coins and building my defenses. Instead it's a rather boring, complicated slog of never ending tasks with very little actual combat I wanted a game I could dip into to kill some time. I wasn't looking for a world-building experience

DO NOT PLAY!!! first of its nothing like the ads, it's a money pit, and as a f2p it is difficult to enjoy it's farm ville at that point. if you do spend make sure you have it because they will say they will refund you, and wait till you use something from what you bought and say oh we can't anymore yes even 2 days later. so don't forget either. and they are constantly releasing stuff so if you do spend it's likely something better will come out. there for playing Farmville again.

Clicked on a tower defense game ad only to encounter yet another stupid base builder bait and switch. The gameplay in the ads should be the core gameplay. Anything else is deceptive. Dear devs: Read more closely. Don't advertise something that is only a tiny portion of your game like it is your whole game and then try to handwave the problem with a stock reply.

This is another example of a completely different game from what was shown on the ads. I was shown a fun tower defense game with resource collecting along the way for upgrades. What we are presented with is basically and idle resource town builder, where you occasionally fight so you can unlock more buildings or upgrade the ones you have. It's just another hero collecter mobile slop game like so many others.

I'm an hour or so in and the only active choice I've made is to *not* spend premium currency to speed up the "game". I click where the big finger tells me to click and have no idea why, and no clear repercussions to not. I clicked because I saw ads with gameplay that are nothing like the game so far... no running around map collecting coins and depositing on squares to build defenses AT ALL. should be labeled false advertising. EDIT: Dear developer, then show more of the game in your ads.

So far nothing about this game is like the ads. They share absolutely no similarities. the game itself isn't fun or interesting. I found myself just mindlessly pressing buttons to "upgrade" my town while nothing meaningful happened. Completely trash game. If they would just make one exactly like the one from the ads with nothing else to it, that'd be perfect.

Despite not being remotely like the hundreds of ads I've seen for this game, I still found it entertaining. while I have made a few in-game purchases, I don't see the complaint that it's pay to play. I progressed significantly & quickly before even making my first purchase. Also, I thought this game was supposed to have zero ads. However, the in-game ads are driving me crazy constantly pulling you out of focus from whatever task you are performing to show you a pop up ad for upgrades.

Don't Bother. like most mobile games today, game isn't whats shown in the ads. theres no progressive tower-defense style gameplay. its like Last War; you build and level a village/city, train troops, and participate in events. Like all games of this style, a couple whales (pay to win is 100% a thing regardless of what the ads say) will just stomp everyone in the server. and the feedback survey the devs give you is only open for the first few days youre in the game, before you have any idea.

Game is like the ads for maybe the first 5 mins you play the game. it's a kingdom builder and there are no ads, but everything costs money. Semi-fun game but once you get to higher levels, very repetitive. Also, you have people in the game that drop thousands of dollars who will destroy you and you can't make top 50 of any competition as a Free-2-Play player. just know what you are getting into before playing.

DON'T SPEND ACTUAL MONEY, it will get you NO WHERE! It's fun building the kingdom and the island. but then it becomes impossible to move forward unless you wait weeeekkkss, or spend cash. Fun game while its free and spending a little money. but then it gets ridiculous. Spend $5 to get 15 puzzle pieces when each small upgrade costs 40. This is fine if there is a point to the game, but its just never ending. Everytime you upgrade, the game just gets impossible to beat unless you spend more real $

I rarely do. but this time I decided to make a purchase in the game and they charged me way more than advertised, so I contacted support, they started to claim that google over charged me and that it is a currency exchange. I checked and it wasn't true. They then started to mention the prices of other packs not purchased and they continued to argue then they claim that they didn't overcharge me. luckily I showed my bank all the relevant facts and they fully refunded me.

I think the customer service is getting information & either sharing it or selling it because they can't log into players accounts so they ask for screenshot of everything that's wrong or possibly wrong & I believe there's shadowing/over shadowing or duplication of accounts going on. I spent quite a bit on top ups & I've had resources go missing & not just a few. I've had peices of equipment go missing, there's been glitches & other abnormalities in the game play including but not limited to....

super fun game, the problem is I just spent money in the game for the first time yesterday and ever since, I'm being interrupted every 30 seconds with offers for more packages. I literally can't play the game because I'm being forced to look at 5$ packages over and over. I spent 2 freaking dollars and I'm about to delete the game because of it. I'm NOT spending more money just because you interrupt my play with more attempted pocket picking.

FALSE ADVERTISEMENT. No tower defense at all. you build stuff, then basically every event is about completing tasks (to use up your resources and buy more). absolutely feared towards micro purchases and p2p. the battle/War aspect of it is between getting burned down by other bigger toxic players, not battling at all (depending on which kingdom/server you're in), and basically no strategy at all. Just repetitive events masked as new but really the exact same thing (e.g. spend speedups for points)

what's crazy to me is the developer literally openly admitting to false advertising in the reviews of this game. I guess because it's free with in app purchases maybe it's different but it's still literally the most scummy practice on the face of this planet. I haven't even opened the app and the torrent of reviews about how many ads are ACTUALLY in Kingshot got me to uninstall before even launching. Also wouldn't surprise me if they were scraping your data as well. Save your storage space.

there is no tower defense and like most games when you 1st see the game it's not like that at all. it's another build the base train soliders collect rss build gear etc. False advertisement from the start. it's free to play but know that it will take a long time to advance without a paying. And your response is play the game more. The 1st 3 minutes tells you that its anything but what you advertised

Terrible. Just as others say, misleading. I really wanted to like this game. If it was more like the ads, I probably would have. But it's not. Why not just make the game more like the ads? Get rid of all that other nonsense. You could scrap the rest of it. Keep the ppl who developed the tower defense portion, and fire the rest of the team. That's the part of the game everyone likes about the game. After playing it for an hour or so, I feel cheated. Uninstalling. No more of my time. Sorry.

1st, dozens of hours in and it is 100% not a tower defense game: the ads are dishonest (the response from dev misses the mark). 2nd, the game is pay to win, with players who pay the most at the top of the score board. 3rd the dev puts out events with achievements tied to spending money but does grant the rewards for past spending. Greedy, dishonest, and the definition of pay-to-win. No more payments from me.

The ad is the game I wanted to play, a mindless strategy, offline, simple game. The game you get, while "deeper", is nothing but a tease to spend the money required to compete in the game. Half of the game is inaccessible without spending a fortune. This is a game targeted at "whales."

Lots of bullying in the game. I wasted 3 months playing this game, trying to build up my town. Then, all of a sudden, 2 other players at extremely high levels with 5 times the resources attacked me over and over and over until I lost everything I worked for the past 3 months. Don't waste your time on this game because the developers allow others within the game to bully others.

Don't Believe the marketing. They spent money advertising a type of game play that doesn't represent your actual experience in game. While the developer will claim elements are there, to me it's one big trojan horse. They lore you into downloading a game that you won't be playing in a practical sense. This is deceptive in nature and I wouldn't play this for free. While the actual game can be entertaining, once the trust is gone, no thanks. What other malicous things are they capable of.

Finally downloaded after seeing roughly 20,000 ads... it won't open or load! Update... it finally did whatever connection that it was freezing up on. My phone is a higher end model with more than enough storage, so it wasn't a device issue. In any case it plays fine... Not sure how long it'll hold my attention, but clean game play so far.

You might have seen the misleading ads of this game showing a tower defense type of gameplay. The game might look "a bit" like that at the very beginning but then evolve quickly into a very different and greedy P2W type of game. Tons of rewards give the illusion of generosity when in fact the progression is incredibly slow and repetitive. Many times you'll see some event blocking the final reward with the condition of buying a pack of minimum amount. Don't waste your time and money on this.

Pay 2 win, not tower defence at all. Predatory with the amount of packs and pop ups, events and activities that sure you into buying. some events can't be complete without buying! Whales absolutely ruin the game with their massive power over others. They can wipe you out and 'zero' you so you have to start rebuilding again, so anything you spent can be gone in an instant. Pay 4.99 to get absolutely minimal stuff and packs that are designed for you to increase buying. Stay away.

So far its fun... but I feel I will hit a point where doing something will require so much wait time that playing without paying won't be possible... if that point arrive, I will come back and reduce my rating to 1 star, if that point don't arrive, I will give it 5 stars. EDIT: Gave it 2 stars. You can play without paying (got to level 11) but it gets longer and longer and more boring as most of the game is either waiting or farming.

It's a good game, story and gameplay are cool. There's 2 things I think can be improved: 1. takes time to get stamina (without buying) - 1 stamina every 10mins?. 2. for "speeding" up things it costs too much gems...i.e 3 mins left on something and it costs 49 gems (without speed-ups)! Also to "buy" stamina it costs 300 gems for 10 stamina. Way too overpriced. ! Should be 300 gems for 100-150 stamina. Apart from these, it's a nice game 😄

Definitely not a bad game on the surface, but it actually just recycles concepts from similar games and presents them as something novel. Also progress is exceptionally fast and the game quickly becomes repetitive, with the player being forced to grind just to get one more level on the town hall. Exciting in the beginning, dull after a few days of play.

The ad is very misleading. Not at all like the game. I have been playing for a while now, but have had enough. There is no autonomy. Pre determined placement for buildings, advancement dependent on alliances, it feels too structured. Not at all what I had hoped for. Again, not at all like the ad either. Which is the case majority of the time with these games.. One upside is there are no ads. Although a pop up to try to get me to buy gems would open every damn time for a bit there. Promotional.

The gaming is nothing like the ad says but there are no Ads in the game. The game is Free to play but you cannot progress much if you don't spend money on it. There is no power division or separation so a Pay 2 Play player can easily defeat the new players and it can ruin the experience for them. There are not many skills required to play the game, just spend the money and buy your first place. Feedback: There should be a separate server for the heavy spenders so F2P players can thrive.

Even if you have spent a lot in this game, when the time comes that you want your personal facebook account unbinded, they will ask you receipts that are not available due to being lost. Provided all the other receipts (100+) but still not enough. I highly recommend not to play this game as they are more interested in new players than the loyal paying ones.

Game looks nice. starts off good but it's ultimately not a game, it's a huge cassino in the end. Since it allows for players to spend unlimited amounts of money to level up, some people always use too much money and trampled everyone else. Getting your kingdom to survive the first 60 days is a nightmare. Just saying if you plan to okay this for more than 30 days then don't waste your time.

it's a good game, but also extremely pay to win. the range for cost if you want to compete is between $5000 and $10000 and more! no, I'm not joking. if developers were smart they would lower prices. the result would be many more people buying, and them making a lot more money. but they rely on whales spending as much as I mentioned. pretty sad, and very predatory.

Misleading ads. The gameplay is not like the ads. The gameplay is like other game where the theme is building, looting and upgrading your base. AND YES, IT IS P2W. The ads that we see only 0.1% of the gameplay. If you think the gameplay is like the ads, I don't think you will like this game. Absolutely 1 star because of the misleading ads. You never see the real gameplay on the ads.

Fun game, lots of things to do, but ultimately ends up requiring the player to either pay to win or grind so much that the game stops being enjoyable and feels more like a day job. First of all, this game has nothing to do with the ads you've seen. This is essentially a collection of mini games packaged as an empire building game. None of the mini games are polished, and there is no skill involved at any point of the process. This is a dopamine injector; every action has a reward, you even get rewards for losing. And, as you can expect, there are microtransactions at every single corner of this game. It's actually astounding how many there are. Damn there's a lot.

I played this for about a month. As always, the game is nothing like the ads. All I seemed to do on this game was upgrade buildings, then upgrade buildings, then upgrade buildings..... it seemed to me very complex game with no real direction in what I needed to achieve, oh except for upgrading buildings. then on the day of deletion of the game, I was greeted by a message that my village was destroyed and I will have to start back at zero again. NAH good riddance. don't waste your time or money.

The main reason for such a low score is marketing. The game was advertised to me as a tower defense but in fact it's yet another mix of auto-battler, idle strategy and gacha game. UPD: after playing for several months I uninstalled the game, it's very time consuming, most events have a strict schedule and you need to play with your guild to get rewards. It's not like you can play whenever you have 5 minutes to spare.

Misleading ad. I'm at town hall level 21 and I can say for sure the game is not like how the ad is. This game is more like war management where you constantly upgrade buildings and train units. You then participate in events, collect resources, and attack other players if you feel like it, along with your clan mates. Quite boring and repetitive after awhile and it's not a game for me.

False Advertising, literally every video ad of this game represents nothing actually found in this game. No ads, sure, but with the number of in-game purchase advertisements always in your face, I actually miss the ads. Hugely pay to win, and I'm talking "four figures" kind of money to get anywhere. Would be cheaper to build a high-end gaming desktop and actually play a real game. Too bad i can't rate it lower.

I've accidentally downloaded this game 3 times, because the ads are fun to play. The actual game requires more strategy than I can do. I'm not patient enough to wait for the upgrades after a while. And I just don't understand the whole upgrading fighters part, and... it hurts my brain. BUT, I love playing these ads. PLEASE can you make a dumbed-down version; make an actual game of the version you use for the ads. "Kingshot 4 Dummies". That would suit me fine! 😁

So this game is interesting, the ads for this game are total clickbait, nothing is similar in the least. The game is repetitive, and gets boring quick with a ton of waiting involved. Once you hit a certain level you're then thrown into PVP with other alliances. The problem then stands, those players can pay a ton of money in the shop to get ahead and just burn you constantly if you can't keep up. It's an unfair game that gives full advantage to playing payers. Imo not fun after a certain point.

Fun for a while, but the ads are completely misrepresenting what kind of game this is. The ads makes it seem like it's a tower defense base-building game. It's not. It's a competitive multiplayer game with longer and longer wait timers for building, upgrading buildings and researching. And guess what? It's pay to win. People who spend money on this game (and I mean a *lot* of money) will be further ahead than others and will be able to beat virtually anyone in battle, arena, or anything really.

The ads you see are fake, obviously. it's essentially a reskin of Whiteout Survival so far, but with pve enemies attacking you every so often. it's fun, but falsely advertises itself a bit, which is deliberate. monetisation will get more aggressive in the future as the playerbase grows, with numerous event passes to buy for more progression and Heroes to collect to stay at the top. If you're casual, you're fine. If you're competitive, you'll be spending a lot of money

I downloaded this game because the ads made it look fun, unique, and full of actual gameplay. Unfortunately, the real game is nothing like what was shown. once you open the app you just get a completely different experience. It felt misleading and honestly a waste of time. If the developers advertised the real gameplay, I might have given it a fair chance and most likely enjoyed the game. But when the entire download is based on false advertising, it’s hard to.

I have never had a game advertised as much to me as this game. "NO ADS" shouted repeatedly through my speakers. For a game with such a big focus on ads, it is almost impressive how misleading their own ads are. The ads suggest some fun archeroo type game, which is only a small minigame aspect of this stupid clash of clans clone. It might even be a decent game on its own, but the misleading and annoying ads for it have left me no choice but to leave a 1 star review.

Just another 4X. It doesn't offer anything new to the genre. It was not for me. Once your town center hits lvl 5 it opens up to more of what the game has to offer. That is the point I decided it wasn't what I was looking for. My rating is based on the misrepresentation of the add I saw. The add only demoed the pre 4x part, the reason I tried it. The add presented a very different game. This is a huge problem on the Google Play Store and Add system. Too many companies lying on the platform

Not as shown in the ads. it's actually a pretty decent basebuiler (think the same mechanics, as every other game that uses a misleading ad and you're picturing this), and if i was after that, it'd probably get 5 stars. aside from a very minimal "raid" portion that is nearly a TD game however, if you wanted to get this because you liked the ads you were getting bombarded with in other aps; this isn't for you

It is a game that replicates game-like games. It is the same as the rest of them who have only changed characters from beer. It is also not a weed as shown in the ads. If you are deceived by the ads, you will be in the dream forty. A game that sees game carvers as a cow to be milked. They say there are no ads in the game, but their own ads are already enough on their own. Also, they are too expensive and unnecessary.

I downloaded the game expecting a tower defense experience, but it’s actually a base-building game with resource management. The gameplay is interesting, just not my style. Still, if you like base management and strategy, it’s a solid and fresh option. No ads, which is great, but it feels a bit pay-to-win. Overall, it’s fun and well-made—just not what the ads make it look like

A bit of a strange game. P2W aside, it's a game that is like a collection of multiple different games in one. base building, hero collecting, tower defense. It is trying to do all of these things to capture as much of an audience as possible. The problem is that the game is trying to have multiple genres while not excelling at any of them. It's just a huge time sink and in the end you will not feel satisfied.

Do not play this game... You will regret your time after level 10. After level 10 (which you need more after this level), the game decreases simultaneous construction numbers to one. Normally it is two and you need to pay to increase two (back) again. I will not pay this. Not because it is a lot of money (which is not - £2.99) but God knows what they will reduce and want you/me to pay in the future...

I've played quite a few games like this and where Kingshot drops in my opinion is in the ridiculous and unnecessary gatekeeping of achievements behind paid packages. any time there's a puzzle/bingo type event where you need to unlock one after another, to eventually get the big price? Well, the last remaining task is always to make a purchase over x amount. I don't mind spending money on games, and often do. But when I'm pressured to to progress, I refuse.

ads are a scam, the advertised gameplay is just a mini game to trick you into investing into the main game. that remind you of evony? good, because it's the same game as evony. and all the other various "Kingdom" games, call of dragons, age of empires Mobile ect. what you see in the ads however, that lasts a few minutes until it transitions into the other games. just like the slide puzzle scam ads for the others.

It's a decent game, played it everyday in the last month. Today I uninstalled the game because it's really stupid how pay-to-win this game is. A lot of the unlockable heroes are blocked behind a pay wall. If you want to fully level up your heroes you have to pay money. If you want to keep up with everyone else you have to pay money. It's just a money grab if you ask me... The game would've been great if you actually stood a chance without having to spend hundreds of irl cash.

This is a timesuck. It is nothing like its ads! The gameplay is completely different. It is not a tower defense. It is a city building. And to this add so many different casino like giftboxes and different in-app currencies. Basically, you have the choice to pay or to be an unemployed pensioner who plays 24 hours a day. How on earth did Google rank this? Amazing. Despite the standardized reply, the gameplay does not match the ads at all. It is still 1*.

The game is ok to play. Enhance your buildings to grow your base. enhance your fighters. unlock new things. Spent a bit of time playing it. So why 1 star and why did i stop? Because of their adverts. Not in game - there arent any. This is yet another game which uses other games and other styles to advertise their game. It's frustrating, it's lazy and as far as I am concerned fraudulent. If you make a game advertise the game you made - not someone elses. edit: i stand by my comment - read it!

Apart from a few graphics, this game is nothing like the ads that have been smashing my ad feed in other games. It's an OK game for what it is but nothing like the ads. If I had known what it really was I wouldn't have downloaded this - it's just another town / empire builder with world alliances. The comment on my review said "it is only a small part of the game" what is in the ads DOES NOT EXIST in the game itself. The only thing in the ads that is in the game is the king graphic.

The obvious: the game is not like the ads. It starts out quite fun; but things start to fall apart. A predatory micro-transaction game with tons of things you can buy with money; but unless you plan on whaling hard, you get minor incremental benefits. Everything in this game is designed for whales bullying others into spending money or leaving the game. Whales and bullies run amok in this game. Avoid at all costs. Just noticed it is tagged as "single player". Another lie.

First, (X) it isn't what was advertised. but it is a "playable game", not suffocating your progress with payment requirements. I played daily for months, not boring. The reason I left it, I couldn't control my time on the game, especially since I'm not a paying player, so I needed to spend more time advancing, and the game will allow you and reward you if you did. sure, the game could be enhanced and be more socially interactive, and in other aspects too. but in general, it is very playable.

The ads are complete lies. You get maybe a couple days of it as a minigame, and then it just stops mattering. Once you've built all the walls, you can quit, because there's nothing else to do in that minigame. Even the real game is annoying. It takes literal days of waiting to build troops, and then someone stupidly powerful can show up while I'm offline, attack a dozen times, and destroy weeks' worth of time. What's even the point? The PvP doesn't matter and isn't fun.

And the app now freezes when opened. It freezes at checking version. Adverts aren't true. They show some kind of tower defense, but the actual game is a p2w world. Crazy to advertise something completely different. It's an interesting game for a bit, until it gests a bit repetitive. And, yes devs, I have explored the game and seen all the game play, there's no tower defense aspect apart from a very tiny 2-min side quest.

slightly misleading advert. Yes, you do fight invaders, but that's like 5% of the gameplay or less. Most of the game is spent building stuff. It's less about playing tower defense and more about building a settlement. I have uninstalled it when the world map was introduced. I didn't stick around, but I can already guess there will alliances, other players and whatnot. I guess this game isn't for me. The advert made it seem like a tower defense, single player game. Not this

It's true: There are no ads. But, you guessed right: (It's that other modern day mobile game issue:) This TD gameplay either comes quite later in the game or simply doesn't exist! It has those group of heroes enemy encounter RPG auto fight aspects, but as it seems these screenshots on the store page are not from the game itself. Other than that it's the same old "build your town and keep upgrading" scheme going on and on, at some point you might just ask yourself: where was I? really, though..

The game has nothing to do with the ad, it's just another one of those thousands of games where you need to build all sorts of buildings, upgrade soldiers, research, join an alliance, and blah blah blah. Nothing original, just copy and paste of what several developers out there have already done. The portion where the king shoots arrows on the enemies is just a detail in this whole old story already seen multiple times. Fed up with the total lack of originality, and misleading ads.

Game is nothing like the ad. In the beginning, first 10min of gameplay MAYBE is something like that, but after that. No. It's a classical castle-building battle game. As usual, servers are ruled by P2W players and difference is huge. It's not too bad though, you can keep evolving even being hunted by P2W players, most of loses are not permanent and you can freely "resurrect" your troops, just need some time.

same old stuff... you've played one you've played all. Queue to build taking forever... heroes to unlock and level up but never the premiums... upgrading your buildings will cost you a crazy amount of resources until it will take you a month to get one upgrade... if you want to spend money on this you might have fun at a costly price ! even the additional queue to build is 10€/$. Mobile editors have lost track of prices I guess. Remember than any AAA games on any platform is 70€/$

The game is nothing like the adverts at all! But this is not why it's 3-star. The gameplay is not about playing but simply collecting bonuses and rewards and clicking on things in a cyclical manner over and over. This seems to be the standard these days, no actual gameplay just simply having people repeat tasks, slowly extend the time it takes for things to build until they get frustrated and spend money. The game isn't advertisment heavy but also lacks depth and becomes unengaging quickly.

Don't fall for it. It starts off okay and good, but it is a HIGHLY PAY TO PLAY GAME. Trust me, I've been one of the most goated players on my server, and I guarantee that mere skills and tacts won't get you where you want to be, you need money, and once you start spending it becomes an endless abyss. YOU JUST PAY AND PAY AND PAYYYYY. The game is really nice overall, but the pay part is very frustrating at one point of time, because it gives you dictators in your server, the big whales set rules

This is a weird one. The game isn't tower defense at all. it's an economy/management game with PvP and PvE aspects. Though I'm enjoying this game I struggle to recommend it. the game pushes monetisation hard, a lot of events can't be completed without paying. The pacing of this game of horrific, it starts fast paced as you expect, but it slows down from days, to weeks for some progression which can of course be bypassed by spending money. The UI is also busy and cluttered, expect to get lost.

Nothing like the AD at all!!! I'd rate it higher if the ad was honest because the game is ok but there is not a single part of the ad that is in the game! edit: (replying to devs) my town center is level 28, there isn't any wave based tower defense part to the game where you collect coins and upgrade towers like the ads show. My suggestion is don't make false advertising ads, because the game itself is fun.

The game plays great, but the pay-to-win aspect is way too overpowering. Let's say you returned to the game after a couple of years missing out on the battle passes. Well, now your standard cards have to face against evo and hero cards, all of which have no drawbacks except maybe the mercy of not being in 1-2 cycles. If you think skill solely can get you far, you are mistaken.

Entertaining, yet, completely intentional dishonest ads driving you install the game, then you experience a completely different game mechanism. All the mechanism are introduced (just like MANY other similar game platforms) to convince you do more micro purchases(AND Shiny One-time DEALS!) to get ahead of other players by giving more money, ending up in servers with few couple of non-competing whale players spent a lot of money, a pointless waste of time🤑🫠... You'd enjoy some times though

This game is only 3% what is shown in the ads. In reality, it's age of empires online. If you haven't played that, well it's basically the exact same game as this, just this is re-skinned to be more cartoony. You know the whole, 'tower defense, stand on a tile to spend money to create more defenses' thing you see in the ads? Lies. 100% a lie. This game is not what is advertised. Don't waste your time.

Being fully honest, besides the no ads upside, the game just becomes too repetitive and competitive after a while. It's impossible to play casually unless you are in the big 5 alliances of your server and spend tons of money to keep up with everyone. Though it was fun for a bit as I did play for about half a month and until I got Town Center level 17. So I'd say it's an ok game to try out for a week or two, on a new server.

This game was nice at first but quickly devolved into a low-effort money grab with repetitive gameplay. Just look at how many "discounted packages" are offered ingame and which you'll have to buy once you are past the first week. - No strategy or choices, gameplay repeats forever after finishing the story which is ~10 minutes. - It quickly becomes a grindfeast to cover the lack of any real content. - Dozens of costly ingame purchases that are necessary to play in any meaningful way.

I downloaded this game expecting what looked like a fun Tower Defense game, turns out it's incredibly dull with zero tower defense gameplay. Click a button at the bottom left to build a house, now build a mine by left clicking the same button, now build a barracks, now upgrade the house by using the same button, and now upgrade the barracks etc. It might have no ads but there are plenty of opportunities to buy upgrades to make things happen faster but it's not what was was advertised. Avoid.

the customer service is dreadful. i forgot to connect my account, and after the recent major update, all of my data has been wiped off, and i lost my account. i tried to recover through the customer service, and it looks like it is a bot . It took 3 days, and yet nothing happened. I'm very disappointed because i spend money on the games. not recommended!!

False advertising and too repetitive. It's not like the ads and once you do the rounds a couple of times, you find yourself just playing the game to continue chatting to people in your alliance. You hit a wall and need to pump money into the game to progress, as after a certain amount of time it takes forever to level up buildings, etc. Don't bother wasting your time and money on this. Also, it seems virtually impossible to delete your account when you want to leave.

Okay.... The Game play is nothing like the Ad. You guys should fix that. The Ad focuses on a tower defense style game play that happens rarely but even the tower defense style is not even like the Ad. Instead of a streamline of enemies coming along a path its more like portals that open up around your base. This game focuses more on base development and expansion and the grinding of leveling up your heroes and army. It's a shame that it didn't follow through from what was shown in the Ad.

Completely unlike the game play ads. There aren't any tower defence elements, even in the mini games. I have played the game for around a month now, and I haven't seen any content included in those ads - so when the developer comments under this review 'the ads only show a tiny portion of the game' that's plain LIES, it isn't ANYWHERE in the game. These false misleading ads are just scams to get you playing and they should be banned.

It has really misleading ads on youtube. Only a small percentage of gameplay shown on the ads is in the game. The rest of it is a generic city builder game. Just don't waste your time with this game. If you want to play the real deal, play thronefall instead. The thronefall devs deserve it, not the kingshot devs they are just here to make a slop game, and hell, they are already making tons of slop ai ads on youtube.

Terrible game. Like many of these types of game it is only fun if you are a whale and have unlimited money to throw at it. If you're a casual gamer, who doesn't mind giving some money to the developers and are looking for a friendly community and to make friends then this game isn't for you. Everything is over priced and those that can afford the endless loot boxes can ruin the game for people looking to enjoy a game and build something with like minded people.

Edit: The ads do not show ANY of the game! It is not a tower defence game. At all. It is very much false advertising. it's a fun game that I enjoyed my time with. I joined a fun, friendly guild and waged war across the map, there truly were no ads. However, the game is advertised as a sort of tower defence game, and I love those, it is not a tower defence game, it is a city builder. So it gets the lowest score for the false advertising.

Uninstalled after playing for a few months. I was a casual player initially impressed by the game's quality & gameplay despite being initially lied to. The ad for it was a tower defense game. First 3 months was really into it. The more you play the harder it is to level up without microtransactions. The biggest put off is the community. There is no real "casual" players because other alliances are predatory and competitive. If you aren't active daily, you're kicked out. Very demotivating.

The game is fun, but the ads are misleading. Gameplay shown is not of this game but another game on steam, Thronefall, including that game's music which isn't included in this one, nor is any of the gameplay seen in the ads. The only parts in the ad that are true is the governor model you see doing stuff, the model of the town center, the house model and the enemy models. All the rest is not present in the actual game. I thought misleading advertisements weren't allowed in the Google play store?

nothing like the ads. you pay for ads everywhere but they are nothing like your game. its just another city builder time waiting, spend money, "strategy" game Edit: "the tiny portion of gameplay shown in your ads" is the only part of the game you show. it is the only part I want to play. the rest is a generic cash grab "strategy" game. the ad looks fun, your game is not

the game is overly loaded with events, very fast pace, like modern games, it is trying to be addictive, everything has no feeling of upgrade, as it is very quick, fights are lame, you get many things at once, opposite to legendary clash of clans, things are bor8ng here. maybe devs should try to focus more on identity and lore instead of click-win style. I am sorry, but you could have done better.

Absolute trash! I want to give a negative infinity rating of this game! 100% pay to win gameplay! Full of bugs, very battery and network heavy. This is just one of multiple identical clones of a game released under a dozen different titles. The studio is not fixing any bugs, they are just changing the title and the graphics a bit and releasing the same game over and over again.

The game itself is decent. Building the city etc is good times. The other players ruin the game. High level people will target lower level players constantly to a point where you can't progress. You spend 8 hours recovering from an attack to then be attacked again. The game allows people of a very high level to simply walk over lower level players with ease. Devs should implement a system where you can only target players a few levels below you to make this game enjoyable.

Absolutely nothing like the adverts, not quite sure why its allowed to advertise something totally different. False advertising and the game itself is rather boring and constantly begging to spend money. I get these games cost money to design etc but its excessive! Would get more stars if it was anything like its adverts, even as a side quest mode!! Very much like the game whiteout, another lying game. Wait for the standard copy and paste response from the developer saying the ad only shows....

The ADs make it seem like a tower defense game. It's not. Maybe 5% is TD, the rest is town building, strategy, diplomacy and random mini-games. For me, this made it much less fun. The ADs are correct though, in that there are no in-game ADs. Some micro transactions though, but they mostly seem to be "pay to win"; not really necessary.

Installed this because of a trailer that showed loads of fighting. Liked the fact that you level up buildings etc. but there's little to no tutorial and I had no idea what I was doing. The game just kept saying "click here" so thinking the game should really be playing itself, I uninstalled it. Okies the fact it KEEPS adding me if I want personalised ads. No I don't and I'm fed up having to choose.

*Once I saw that the developers used AI-generated Ad, uninstalled immediately* I don't even know why do I download mobile games anymore. Every multiplayer is very pay-to-win. You have a zero chance of being even close to top players (whales who dump tons of real currency) as a free player. But yet again... playing free is like a trial of the game. The thing is that the full experience costs literally hundreds of euros, if not thousands.

Good graphics and such, but there is WAAAAY too much meaningless storyline, and the "help" tutorial throws so much at you all at once that you can't learn how to play. This game promised tower defense, but that turns out to be a small fraction of the game, so it feels very bait-and-switch. I was hoping that this would be good, but it is yet another game advertised with lies.

100% Reskinned Version of WhiteOut Survival... if you've played that game, this is exactly the same, despite looking quite different during the early stages. Complete grind-fest, masses of repetition and a progress arc that ticks over at a progressively slow (ok glacial) pace unless you are prepared to stump up real cash (why would you, there's no real reward in the gameplay of this paper-thin cash cow). Not recommended - it'll milk your time and/or wallet without giving a return on investment.

It's alright for a mobile game and you don't have to pay (at least as long as I was playing) It's basically Tribal Wars but less brutal. Community was decent which was the best thing tbh. Rating is for the lying ads. There is next to NO tower defense element to this game - what the ads show you just isn't present at all. the closest thing to Tower defense is a mini game you can literally go to sleep for.

first of all it's not like the ads you don't kill enemies collect coins and build towers, it's just a simple story based game whwrin you need to upgrade buildings and WAIT sometimes a threshold is reached and you get to find some actions in which a group of enemies Willa attack your town but it's pretty easy no challenge you won't be defeated, it's just there to stir up time so you will wait again, also the main goal of this game is to make you watch ads. this is just some chinice company bs

Saw an ad, came here to download just so I could leave a bad review. Glad to see other reviews saying the ad is false. More than that, it's blatant plagiarism. There's an amazing game called "Thronefall" and the ad is an inferior copy of that. Go and find "Thronefall" if you liked the ad, so the money goes to the people who actually made an effort.

Unfortunately, although it was a brilliant game that I've spent many hours playing and also spent money buying packs and bits for and then they have a system glitch. It stops you from logging in for days due to this issue. They then fix this, however when I log in only to find out half of my achievements have reset. ZERO help from customer services, they ignored my last 7 messages. So now raising a visa dispute with the bank for items purchased. Items that have now vanished with ZERO help. SHAME

It's nothing like the ads you see around social media, more like CoC, the game is fun itself, you can build the city without paying but it takes forever. micro transactions are way to much, meat, training, bulding, etc. I could have been playing but there are big wallet players that harass others because they can, keep that in mind, if you report that to the devs, they just simply ignore you because money talks. If you down for it, go ahead, just don't take it seriously.

Uninstall!! DO NOT USE PAYPAL TO MAKE PURCHASE!! In the event that you lose access to you email, the email that you use to make Google purchase, they will not accept PayPal as a method of verification for your account. I have tried for 17 days to regain an account, only to be put on an endless loop of 37 agents in same ticket asking me to resubmit over and over. best thing to do? Don't play, don't pay!

Nothing like the ads The ads show a medieval version of a game I've played before where you go down a path getting coins by killing enemies and using those coins to build towers to help you reach the next area and progress down the path. However this game is nothing like that, this is a base building game where you have to collect resources to build your base.

Another misleading ad, why do they do this? Just give us the game you advertise.... The game is maybe 5% tower defense, the rest.... base building and resource management. Its good if thats what you want although I suspect that it would become very heavily pay to win after a while. Very little gameplay is actually "tower defence" and that becomes apparent very quickly. No clue where all the high reviews come from. Honestly, if you want actual tower defence, dont bother wasting your time..

It is OK as a game, but very misleading compared to ads. Unfortunately it is not even close to that. It is just very very similar to other games like building management, economy etc. You can find many games like this. Too bad. And I saw the replies like it is a portion of the game etc. Which is not an excuse, if it is just a portion, than don't make ad of it. Just tell the truth.

Couldn't tell you anything about the game itself because it's hidden behind an agonisingly slow (even with the 'skip' button that does basically nothing) series of unnecessary cutscenes, forced 'choices' (you know the kind, the kind low effort games use to stop you thinking for yourself) and somehow they thought it was a good idea to not give you any access to settings during this. So you can't silence the stupid game. I gave it a go, but its not worth sitting through all that. no ads tho
your usual pay to win game. it's not skill based, it's wallet based. I've played the game, on two different servers. can't compete unless I want to spend hundreds of dollars.

Game is good fun. Progression is satisfying, graphics are nice, monetization isn't overly aggressive, no ads. However, the currency sometimes bugs to USD instead of GBP and sometimes doesn't allow me to make purchases. Reloading the game usually fixes this, but a bit weird. Also I am playing on a Samsung Fold, but the game doesn't display correctly on a larger screen. Good potential anyway, will be interesting to see the future of the game.

The game is nothing like what they advertise, but is instead a clash of clans clone. This part of the game is boring and as every other game like it was created to make you spend money to not wait. Everything in the game has already been seen on other games in higer quality. Even when you play what you installed the game for it's nothing like the ad, there is no tower defence mechanic because it's based on the CoC part of the game. Boring, scummy and uninspired, this is the truth behind the ads.

IF you have a problem support will tell you it's your device not the game. It can be fun to play for a while, but the higher you go, the disparity between paying players & rest of people becomes bigger and bigger. non stop events where top 10 players get stronger with each one. The paywall hero is so expensive to get that again, only the strongest player will get him, and you stand no chance against them. One whale can wipe out an entire strong alliance. But it doesn't have ads so that's that

I’ve been facing issues with the game on Wi-Fi. All other apps work fine, so the problem is not from my internet or device. I reinstalled the game several times as instructed, but it still disconnects after 20–30 minutes and shows me offline. It’s affecting my gameplay and experience. I hope this issue is fixed soon. Until then, I can’t give a higher rating. Please check and solve the problem as soon as possible.
